team.title: Team
team.description: Team members, roles and today’s check-ins
team.emptyHint: Invite your first team member to get started.
team.loadError: We couldn't load the team. Please try again.
team.noMatch: No one in this structure yet
team.noMatchHint: Nobody on the team teaches a class here yet.
team.count: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}

roleDescriptions.owner: Full access: manages everything, including settings and the team.
roleDescriptions.admin: Runs day-to-day operations: children, team, attendance and finances.
roleDescriptions.educator: Manages their class: attendance, activities and child follow-up.
roleDescriptions.staff: Limited access: their own check-ins and basic information.
roleDescriptions.accountant: Finances only: invoices, payments, expenses and payroll.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: Create an invitation link for a new team member, or give someone already on the team a login.
invite.identifier: Reserve for an email or phone number
invite.openHint: Left empty, anyone who opens the link joins the team as {role}.
invite.boundHint: Only the account signed up with this address or number can accept it.
invite.attachTo: Attach to an existing team member
invite.attachHint: The login is added to {name}'s existing record — timesheets, payslips and door credentials stay put.
invite.linkHelpOpen: Anyone who opens this link joins as {role}. It expires in 14 days.
invite.linkHelpBound: Share this link with {identity}. Only their account can accept it, and it expires in 14 days.

join.acceptAs: {tenant} invites you to join its team as {role}.
join.authIntro: Create an account or sign in to join {tenant}.
join.bound: This invitation is reserved for one account: sign in with the email address or phone number it was sent to.

unknown.title: This invitation link is not valid
unknown.body: Check the link as you received it, or ask your kindergarten's administrator to send a new one.

accepted.title: This invitation has already been used
accepted.body: It was accepted once and cannot be reused. If that was you, sign in; otherwise ask the administrator for a new link.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations are valid for 14 days. Ask your kindergarten's administrator to send a new one.

mismatch.title: This invitation is reserved for another account
mismatch.body: It was sent to a different email address or phone number. Switch to that account, or ask the administrator for a link reserved for this one.

alreadyMember.title: You are already on this team
alreadyMember.body: This account already belongs to the kindergarten, so there is nothing to accept.

invite.structuresHint: Where this person will work. Tick several if needed — leave empty for the whole building.

edit.title: Edit member
edit.description: Role, job title, salary and codes for {name}.
edit.monthlyHint: Fixed monthly salary, independent of clocked hours.
edit.hourlyHint: Pay is computed from the hours recorded on the timesheet each month.

detail.notFoundHint: This member doesn't exist or has been removed.

timesheets.dialogDescription: Manual entries are recorded in the audit log.

leaves.title: Leave
leaves.requestDescription: Your request will be sent to management for a decision.
leaves.dateError: The end date must be after the start date.
leaves.approveDesc: The request is marked approved and the person finds it under their leave.
leaves.rejectDesc: The request is marked rejected. The person can file another one.
leaves.conflicts: {name} {lessons, plural, =0 {has no lesson} one {teaches # lesson} other {teaches # lessons}} and {sessions, plural, =0 {no follow-up} one {# follow-up} other {# follow-ups}} over this period — they stay scheduled, without a replacement.

salary.advancesHint: Advances paid out and whether they were repaid

invites.title: Invitations
invites.emptyHint: Create an invitation from the Team page.
invites.revokeDescription: The link sent to {email} will stop working.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do that.
errors.noSuchAccount: No account uses this email or number yet.
errors.alreadyMember: That account is already on this team.
errors.alreadyLinked: This member already has a login.

badge.title: Staff badge
badge.scanHint: Scan this at the kiosk to clock in and out.
badge.noCodeBody: Add a code on the member's profile before printing a badge.

local.description: For a team member with no email. They are created here and handed a code and PIN for the kiosk.
local.pinOnce: The PIN is shown once. Write it down now — it is never displayed again.

structures.title: Structures
structures.hint: Where this person works. One structure, or several — the kitchen feeds the whole building.

classes.noneInBuilding: No class has been created yet.
